title: Ordinary order from a device never seen before, behind a VPN
narrative: A $110 online order, in line with the customer's usual spend and frequency. The device has never been seen on the account and the IP is a VPN exit, in the billing country.
rationale: An unrecognized device combined with an anonymizing proxy is the core account-takeover pattern, even at a normal amount; fraudsters often test a taken-over account with an ordinary order. Each signal alone would pass, together they warrant verification. The project's own prompt asks for exactly this: weigh how signals combine, and treat uncertainty as review, not approve.
